scope: Corollary 4.6 of the manuscript “B-semiampleness for compact log-smooth Kähler fibrations” (preprints/B-semiampleness-for-compact-log-smooth-Kahler-fibrations-September-10-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 afad4b593eede2dd), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The expression (4.11) is a positive finite norm, homogeneous of degree one, on the volume line. Let a clear the indicated powers. Along any disk in P whose punctured part lies in P◦, after a sufficiently divisible power substitution, a nonvanishing local frame of r∗ OS(amMS) and its dual have at most powers-of-log growth in the a-th tensor power of this norm and its dual norm. No Kähler assumption on P is required.
